No claim passed the verifier [C-neg1]. In three attempts, no relation was individually confirmed, and the $12\times9$ matrix has 0 singular values below 1e-24 and 8 above 1e-8, the smallest of the large values being 2.44e-8 [C-neg1]. The fourth attempt returned no verifiable relation [C-neg1]. We therefore state no weight-6 result [C-neg1].

## Discussion, limitations and open questions

All statements about $C(a,b,c)$ rest on 32-digit evaluations at 4 verifier points [C-modell] and on singular-value gaps [C-modular-R1]. This constitutes numerical evidence, not proof. The dimension 1 found at each weight is a statement about the tested function sets only [C-modular-R1][C-modular-R1b][C-modular-R1c][C-modular-R1d]. Because the weight-eleven computation is still running, we make no statement beyond weight 9 [C-modular-R1d]. The novelty status of the weight-9 relation is inconclusive [C-modular-R1d].

Open questions:

(i) Is the relation at each weight provable, for example by exact reduction of the lattice sums?

(ii) Does the generating-series count of arXiv:2004.05156 reproduce the dimension of the weight-9 relation space [C-modular-R1d]?

(iii) How does the pattern continue at weight eleven?
